newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangnan mulls eel farm spinoff.
newsitem.headline: Guangnan mulls eel farm spinoff.

text.p: Guangnan (Holdings) Ltd said on Wednesday its 67 percent-owned indirect subsidiary Hong Kong Chaozhou Industries Ltd, had decided to pursue the possibility of a Hong Kong listing by way of a new issue in early 1997.
Hong Kong Chaozhou is principally engaged in the farming and roasting of eel and the processing and trading of other aquatic produce, it said in a statement.
An advance booking form for listing had been submitted to the stock exchange but the timetable and financial terms of the proposed listing had not yet been finalised, the company said.
"Assuming the proposed listing becomes unconditional, Hong Kong Chaozhou Industries will remain as an indirect subsidiary of the company," it added.
